answer: Make every identity spend wall-clock time it cannot parallelize. Each epoch a beacon hands each key a fresh seed, and the key must return a verifiable delay function output: 2^30 sequential squarings in a class group, about six hours on one dedicated core, checked by anyone in milliseconds with a Wesolowski proof. Squarings cannot be split across cores, so a nebula of 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 cores busy all day, while an honest agent spends one. Outputs chain epoch to epoch like crystal layers; skip one and the key restarts at zero weight, a cost as fixed as marble.
